<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>public</access><active>false</active><api_name>x_587457_pear.PEAR_PreviewAPI</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>true</client_callable><description/><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>PEAR_PreviewAPI</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script><![CDATA[var PEAR_PreviewAPI = Class.create();
PEAR_PreviewAPI.prototype = Object.extendsObject(global.AbstractAjaxProcessor, {

  // ]]>🔹<![CDATA[ Metodo base per la UI Page
  getApplicativeAccess: function() {
	//gs.info('Calling getApplicativeAccess');
    var out = [];
    var gr = new GlideRecord('x_587457_pear_applicative_access');
    gr.addQuery('enable', true);
    gr.query();
    while (gr.next()) {
      out.push({
        number: gr.getDisplayValue('number'),
        label: gr.getDisplayValue('label'),
        application: gr.getDisplayValue('app_id'),
        business_part: gr.getDisplayValue('business_part_id'),
        project: gr.getDisplayValue('project_space_id'),
        technical_role: gr.getDisplayValue('technical_role_id')
      });
    }
    return new global.JSON().encode(out);
  },

	getApplicativeAccessByBp: function(rowsJson) {



	if (!rowsJson) {
    	var rowsJson = this.getParameter('sysparm_rowsJson') || '[]';
	}

	gs.info('getApplicativeAccessByBp rowsJson ' + rowsJson);

	//gs.info('Calling getApplicativeAccessByBp rowsJson ' + rowsJson);

    // raccogli i BP selezionati (e i Project se vuoi filtrarli)
    var rows = [];
    try { rows = JSON.parse(rowsJson); } catch (e) { rows = []; }

    var bpSet = {}; // set di BP
    var prjSet = {}; // set di Project (opzionale)
    rows.forEach(function(r){
      if (r.business_profile_mrvs) bpSet[r.business_profile_mrvs] = 1;
      if (r.projects_mrvs) prjSet[r.projects_mrvs] = 1;
    });

    var bpIds = Object.keys(bpSet);
    var prjIds = Object.keys(prjSet);

	gs.info('getApplicativeAccessByBp bpIds.length ' + bpIds.length)
	gs.info('getApplicativeAccessByBp prjIds ' + prjIds.toString())

    if (!bpIds.length)
      return '[]';

    // 1) Business Part attivi per i BP
    var parts = new GlideRecord('x_587457_pear_business_part_of_app_access'); // BP↔App
    parts.addQuery('business_profile_id', 'IN', bpIds.join(','));
    // parts.addQuery('status', 'active');
    parts.query();
	gs.info('getApplicativeAccessByBp parts query ' + parts.getEncodedQuery());
	gs.info('getApplicativeAccessByBp parts count ' + parts.getRowCount());

    // (opzionale) mappa formato accesso per app: role / role_org / role_prj / role_org_prj
    var formatByApp = {};
    var fmt = new GlideRecord('x_587457_pear_app_access_format');
    fmt.query();
    while (fmt.next()) formatByApp[fmt.getValue('app_id')] = fmt.getValue('format'); // 'role', 'role_prj', ...

    var out = [];
    while (parts.next()) {
		gs.info('getApplicativeAccessByBp parts label ' + parts.label + ' license ' + parts.license_id.getDisplayValue())

		var parts_licenses_array = parts.license_id.split(',');
		var parts_licenses_out = [];
		var l = new GlideRecord('x_587457_pear_license');
		for (i=0; i<parts_licenses_array.length; i++)
		{
			if(l.get('sys_id',parts_licenses_array[i]))
				parts_licenses_out.push(l.number.toString())
		}
		var license_id = parts_licenses_out;
		gs.info("getApplicativeAccessByBp license_id " + license_id);


      // 2) Applicative Access abilitati per quel Business Part
      var aa = new GlideRecord('x_587457_pear_applicative_access'); // contiene project_space_id, technical_role_id, ecc.
      aa.addQuery('business_part_id', parts.getUniqueValue());
      aa.addQuery('enable', true);
      aa.query();
		gs.info('getApplicativeAccessByBp aa query ' + aa.getEncodedQuery());
		gs.info('getApplicativeAccessByBp aa count ' + aa.getRowCount());	  
      while(aa.next()) {
		gs.info('getApplicativeAccessByBp QUI')
		var app_id = parts.app_id.number.toString();
		var project_space_id = aa.project_space_id.number.toString();
		var technical_role_id = aa.technical_role_id.number.toString();

		var ap = new GlideRecord('x_587457_pear_access_profile');
		ap.get('business_part_id',parts.getUniqueValue());

		var access_profile_id = ap.number.toString();
		var access_profile = ap.label.toString();

        out.push({
          number: aa.getDisplayValue('number'),
          label: aa.getDisplayValue('label'),
          business_profile_id: parts.getDisplayValue('business_profile_id.number'),
          business_profile: parts.getDisplayValue('business_profile_id'),
		  app_id: app_id,
          application: aa.getDisplayValue('app_id'),
          business_part_id: parts.getDisplayValue('number'),
          business_part: aa.getDisplayValue('business_part_id'),
          project_space_id: project_space_id,
          project: aa.getDisplayValue('project_space_id'),
		  technical_role_id: technical_role_id,
          technical_role: aa.getDisplayValue('technical_role_id'),
		  access_profile_id : access_profile_id,
		  access_profile : access_profile,
		  license_id : license_id,
		  license : parts.getDisplayValue('license_id')
        });
      }
    }
	gs.info('getApplicativeAccessByBp PEAR_PreviewAPI json ' + new global.JSON().encode(out))
    return new global.JSON().encode(out);
  },

    type: 'PEAR_PreviewAPI'
});]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-11-12 22:11:40</sys_created_on><sys_id>1b0093674741f210c361f19f016d43f3</sys_id><sys_mod_count>6</sys_mod_count><sys_name>PEAR_PreviewAPI</sys_name><sys_package display_value="PEAR" source="x_587457_pear">145cb95a47fcb210c361f19f016d439b</sys_package><sys_policy>read</sys_policy><sys_scope display_value="PEAR">145cb95a47fcb210c361f19f016d439b</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_1b0093674741f210c361f19f016d43f3</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-11-12 22:36:59</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include></record_update>
